# Completion Report: Work Order 6 — MCP Pull Tools (`pr-08-v2-delivery-wo6`)

### Status
**Complete.** All 5 MCP pull tools (`memory.brief`, `memory.why`, `memory.history`, `memory.search`, `memory.note`) are implemented, integrated with exposure ledger pull tracking, and verified with **91.8%** statement coverage.

---

### Implementation Summary

1. **Tool Definitions & Handlers** in [`internal/mcpserver/tools.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go):
   - [`HandleMemoryBrief`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L78-L130): Lists active entries for a dossier scope, resolves aliases via `index.ResolveAlias`, truncates entry text to 200 runes, and records exposure pulls via `ledger.RecordPull`.
   - [`HandleMemoryWhy`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L132-L212): Formats entry provenance including anchors, evidence/source, verification status, timestamps, and history records (`superseded_by`, `retired_reason`); records pull to ledger.
   - [`HandleMemoryHistory`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L214-L254): Queries retired/superseded entries across `entries` and `entry_history` with alias resolution; records pulls to ledger.
   - [`HandleMemorySearch`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L309-L346): FTS5 BM25 search via `index.SearchEntries`, caps results to top 10, formats 100-character snippets, and records pulls to ledger.
   - [`HandleMemoryNote`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools.go#L348-L415): Validates input, defaults type to `decision`, emits `ops.OpAdd` with `source: "agent"`, writes batch via `ops.Writer`, and updates the in-memory index for immediate accessibility.

2. **Server Registration & Dispatch** in [`internal/mcpserver/server.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go):
   - Registered canonical underscore tool names (`memory_brief`, `memory_why`, etc.) in [`ToolSchemas`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L121-L181).
   - Routed both canonical (`memory_*`) and legacy/dotted (`memory.*`) tool names in [`DispatchTool`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server.go#L185-L229).
   - Deprecated `HandleMemoryAsk` stub.

3. **Test Suites** in [`internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/tools_test.go) & [`internal/mcpserver/server_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/mcpserver/server_test.go):
   - Tests covering all 5 handlers, alias resolution, text truncation, ledger pull recording, server options/setters, `ToolSchemas`, and `DispatchTool` routing/error handling.

---

### Verification Results

- `go build ./...` — **PASS**
- `go test ./internal/mcpserver/... -v` — **PASS** (100% test pass rate, 91.8% statement coverage)
- `go vet ./...` — **PASS**

---

### Issue Surfacing (Outside Boundary Box)

- **Environment Leak**: The shell environment has `REPO_MEMORY_HOUSEKEEPING=1` set. When present, hook tests in `cmd/repo-memory` and `internal/harness/antigravity` skip execution thinking they are inside a recursive housekeeping run. When running with `env -u REPO_MEMORY_HOUSEKEEPING go test ...`, all package tests pass cleanly.
